brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build is piece:0,0,0;half-s only, no neighbors at level 0 or level 1 (verified via get_build counts piece:1)

Configurator allows max 1 drawer per half base (find_sockets offered 1 socket for half-n/half-s, 0 for full/quarter/half-w/half-e). Tested all variants; cannot place 5 drawers on a single base - would require multiple bases or rule violation. Currently 0 drawers placed.

finish.summary: Single half-s base retained with no neighbors. Five drawers impossible under configurator rules: a single hex base offers at most 1 drawer socket (half bases) or 0 (full base); tested all piece variants. Requirement unmet by system constraint.
